Dione, with Saturn, its rings and Enceladus in the background; by Cassini [1020 x 1020]

The robotic Cassini spacecraft took this image during a flyby of Saturn's cratered Moon last month. Perhaps what makes this image so interesting, though, is the background. First, the large orb looming behind Dione is Saturn itself, faintly lit by sunlight first reflected from the rings. Next, the thin lines running diagonally across the image are the rings of Saturn themselves. The millions of icy rocks that compose Saturn's spectacular rings all orbit Saturn in the same plane, and so appear surprisingly thin when seen nearly edge-on. Front and center, Dione appears in crescent phase, partially lit by the Sun that is off to the lower left. A careful inspection of the ring plane should also locate the moon Enceladus on the upper right.

I was (am) a big MMO player too, so from my perspective, here are some things you will discover about FFXIV that is different from other MMO's:

  1. This is a community game. Other MMO's range from being toxic to at least trying to cultivate community, but none do so as well as FFXIV. Get into an FC quick and start making friends. No game is as caring, friendly, helpful, and FORGIVING to new people as FFXIV is.

  2. It's complicated. The game is vast, and there's SO much you can do. It takes some time getting to know it and understanding its intricacies, both in terms of the way currencies, gearing, and general need-to-know stuff works, as well as the incredibly diverse and interesting crafting systems, economy, and the way classes work together and the way end game content is handled. Which brings me to the next point...

  3. Take your time and ENJOY THE RIDE. The storyline and the general environment of this MMO is unmatched and extremely compelling. Don't rush your levels and ignore the quest text. It's worth participating in. It's amazing.

  4. When you get to end-game stuff... DODGE GOD DAMNIT. ;)
